text: Illustrate the story here: The Big Hut The hen sits in the big hut. The hog sees the hut. The hog asks the hen if he can sit in the hut. The hog and the hen sit in the hut. The dog sees the hut. The dog asks the hen if he can sit in the hut. The dog, the hog, and the hen sit in the big hut.
